name: Group Up Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Group Up Industrial Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and trades in automated process equipment in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company offers precision hot air oven, vacuum oven, hot air conveyor oven, UV curing machine, IR curing oven, coating machine, exposure machine, vacuum laminator, line integration, and other PCB and IC substrate equipment; and glass substrate-TGV, FO WLP/FO PLP, automatic baking system, hot plate oven and VCD unit, dip coater, post UV machine, and peeler.
